messages:
zoe: FYI we have a planned link-handshake firmware update on the us-west2 TOR switches at 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC. Consensus: we should soft-drain affected GPU hosts before the flip to avoid packet-loss-induced evictions. Window ~45m.

darin: How many racks / GPUs are impacted? Any region-wide capacity constraints?

lee: Impact: 6 racks in us-west2-east pod, ~180 GPUs. We have limited spare in-region (saturn-edge ~40 GPUs) and cross-region backfill has high egress and latency cost. Recommend staggered 2-rack cohorts.

tam: Ops plan: 1) cordon 2 hosts in rack -> drain GPU jobs -> verify active sessions <30s -> apply switch handshake flip -> wait 5m for fabric stabilization -> warmbackfill from saturn-edge -> kv-seed top50 routes -> uncordon. Repeat per cohort.

zoe: SLA note: Dedicated pools serving enterprise customers are in a different pod and should be unaffected, but if cross-region backfill kicks in we may need to temporarily route some small traffic which could breach latency SLOs.

darin: Cost ballpark for cross-region backfill if we need it?

lee: If we need to spill ~100 GPUs worth for 20m, egress + compute delta est ~USD 800. If we keep within in-region warmbackfill est ~USD 150.

ops-bot: Runbook created: `run/7443210000-link-handshake`. Steps uploaded. Manual approval required before first flip.

tam: Canary approach: run the same flip on staging rack at 03:00 UTC with a single co-located host to validate that handshake doesn't trigger flow-control evictions. If canary passes, proceed.

zoe: Monitoring: set alert for `tcp.retransmit.rate.us-west2` and `gpu.evictions.rate`. Pager if retransmit >1% or evictions >0.2% for 5m.

sre-bot: Alerts configured. Pager: #eng-oncall if threshold exceeded.

darin: Any config changes to batching or KV settings we should do preflip?

lee: Suggest reducing batch.max_active_requests by 25% for each affected host during the window to reduce inflight windows and avoid timeouts. Also run targeted kv-sync for hot prefixes immediately after uncordon.

tam: kv-sync command:
```
internal-sync --prefix=hot_routes --concurrency=100 --rate=150/s
```
We'll gate it per-rack.

zoe: Customer comms: small advisory to customers with known allowlist for in-region endpoints. Also note possible short-lived p95 latency blips. Drafting message now.

darin: On-call coverage?

lee: On-call: @lee and @tam 03:30-05:30 UTC. Also dev-ex standby for any SDK churn.

zoe: Preflight checklist call at 03:20 UTC in #eng-infra. Please ack availability.

darin: ack

lee: ack

tam: ack

zoe: Post-mortem owner: @zoe. Finance: we'll include final cost in PM.

darin: One more: add a short cooldown (10m) between cohorts to ensure KV seed has time to converge and we don't accumulate a cold-cache storm.

lee: Agreed. Adding 10m cooldown to runbook.

ops-bot: Canary succeeded on staging at 03:00 UTC. No packet-loss observed. Ready for manual approval.

zoe: Manual approve to proceed at 04:00 UTC unless blockers. Posting to status page now.
